facts.fact: Partners for Water reports that in Beira, 20 local staff were trained to scan and register 40,000 plots into a new database holding all land and property data.

MOZ.note: Mentions IT capacity strengthening for Beira only; no office connection.

facts.fact: Partners for Water reports that Beira municipality linked its digitised land registry to its tax collection system, so it knows who owns what and who must pay property tax.
facts.system: Beira land registry linked to property tax

facts.fact: Partners for Water reports the linked registry and tax collection run in the municipality of Beira.
facts.system: Beira land registry linked to property tax

facts.fact: Partners for Water reports Beira as the one municipality running the linked registry and tax system, with other municipalities only showing interest at a December 2024 seminar.
